name: Roselyne Fran
source:
A magician specialising in the processing of departed spirits; she inhabits 霊洩れの途 which gathers the souls of the dead from the Influss kingdom. Her role is to comfort the spirits and guide them to their intended destinations as well as fulfilling any orders from the royal family pertaining to extermination of malicious beings which prey on spirits. 

[Spoiler] Roseline Fran was very young when her family was responsible for murdering the Inlux royal family, a crime which led directly to the kingdom's downfall and its fracture into the successor kingdoms which exist during the game. Her family was sentenced to death for its crimes, Roseline in particular chosen to make penance for eternity as she is bound to the will of the Influss royal line and to obey the orders of the lineage for as long as the line endures. As such she has served the Influss kingdom for over a century, even commanding armies of spirits on the battlefield on the monarch's behest.

Avaro eventually breaks the spell over Roseline, allowing her to age normally once more but now beholden to Avaro's will. She is extremely loyal to her new master but also appreciative of his laissez-faire approach and his order that she find a purpose for living now that she is freed from her former servitude to the Influss royal line. 

Depending on player actions, Roseline either stays with Avaro's trading company as his secretary and accounts manager or resumes her old role as the caretaker of dead souls to save Avaro from the wrath of the Influss kingdom. [/Spoiler]

Roseline is usually accompanied by two spirits dressed in the attire of nobility and wearing distinctive masquerade masks. They serve as her guardians and tend to Roseline's daily needs. When ordered, she can loan out her guardians to the Influss royal family to serve in a military capacity (she normally requires official written orders from the reigning king before she will comply with such requests).
